text: Because you already interact with these systems,
you can easily shift from being a passive consumer to an active user.
and practice using it for something you care about.
Every project gives you experience you can bring to the next one.
We have seen tools close the gap between ideas and creation before,
becoming a designer meant spending years at a drafting table,
learning to draw every line by hand.
Suddenly, a teenager with a personal computer could design posters,
magazines, and brochures from their bedroom.
Instead, it shortened the distance between wanting to do the work and actually doing it.
AI gives you a similar chance to start making things while you build your skills.
